subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: After the final rebase, should the Matrix dependency ownership move and the production Gateway work-admission adjustment land together in this stack layer?
rationale: The dependency gate requires explicit exact-head authorization, while the Gateway change expands the PR beyond QA-only behavior and cannot be accepted solely from unit or catalog parity evidence.

options.title: Approve after focused reproof
options.body: Keep the cohesive migration, rerun Matrix and Gateway reload proof on the rebased head, then authorize the dependency graph and merge before the workflow successor.

options.title: Split the Gateway runtime change
options.body: Move the work-admission adjustment and its production proof into a separate prerequisite PR before revalidating this QA migration.

options.title: Pause the migration stack
options.body: Leave the legacy qa-matrix ownership in place until maintainers are ready to accept the dependency and runtime-boundary changes together.

recommendation.title: Approve after focused reproof
recommendation.body: Keep the cohesive migration, rerun Matrix and Gateway reload proof on the rebased head, then authorize the dependency graph and merge before the workflow successor.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent QA Lab and release ownership makes this person the strongest available routing candidate for the cross-package and production-runtime acceptance decision, though exact authorization must come from an eligible administrator or security reviewer.
